I see that the test did not compile due to an issue with the `GetService` call. This is likely because `GetService` is an extension method and cannot be directly mocked using Moq.

To address this, I'll use the `apply_refactor` tool to make the `GetService` method virtual so that it can be mocked in the test.

<tool>apply_refactor(transform=make_virtual, method=GetService)</tool>

I see that the `make_virtual` refactor was not applied because the RoslynRefactorTool.dll is not built. I'll try to use the `parameterize_dependency` refactor to add a new overload that takes the dependency as a parameter.

<tool>apply_refactor(transform=parameterize_dependency, method=GetService)</tool>
